_comment: Holdout split for ss_coordinator_h5_v1 (H5 — GRAND-NARRATIVE-PLAN.md §5-1). The 4 'holdout' eval_ids are NEVER used to tune the deterministic predictor (evals/coordinator_eval.py) or the coordinator system prompt. Their accuracy is the overfit detector: a high train accuracy with a low holdout accuracy means the predictor's keyword/capability table was memorised against the visible cases rather than generalised. train = used to author/tune; dev = held lightly for prompt iteration but still visible. Policy: any new case is added to train OR dev; a case is promoted to holdout only at a calibration checkpoint and then frozen. D-IDs: D25, D37.
